app_info.subtitle: Evaluate voice and chat agents
app_info.description: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.

test_cases.description: Create, inspect, and safely refine a disposable voice agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a disposable VOICE (MODEL_TYPE_VOICE) agent named OpenAI Reviewer Agent <current UTC timestamp formatted YYYYMMDDHHMMSS> using SIP address sip:openai-reviewer-<same YYYYMMDDHHMMSS timestamp>@invalid.example and prompt 'Disposable reviewer fixture; do not contact users.' Retrieve the new agent, then update only its display name by appending ' — Verified'. Do not start a run.
test_cases.expected_output: After the required confirmations, creates exactly one private voice-agent configuration with the required non-routable SIP address, retrieves it, and changes only its display name. Reports the resulting display name, model type, and endpoint-configured status without starting a run or contacting the SIP address.

test_cases.description: Inspect the stable reviewer evaluation setup without changing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find and retrieve the test set Directory Review Baseline and list only the test cases in that test set. Also retrieve the metric Directory Review: Helpful and Safe and the persona Standard Customer. Summarize the scenarios, expected behaviors, metric purpose, and persona behavior without changing anything.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_test_sets, get_test_set, list_test_cases, list_metrics, get_metric, list_personas, get_persona
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the uniquely named reviewer fixtures and returns a concise summary of the two baseline scenarios and their expected behaviors, the metric's purpose, and the persona's behavior. Performs no writes and omits credentials and unrelated internal fields.

test_cases.description: Create and refine independent disposable evaluation content.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a SCENARIO test set named OpenAI Reviewer Billing <current UTC timestamp formatted YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>. Add exactly one test case where a customer disputes a duplicate charge, with expected behaviors to verify the duplicate and explain the next step. Then update only that test case's description to 'OpenAI reviewer disposable fixture.'
test_cases.expected_output: After the required confirmations, creates exactly one uniquely named test set and one linked test case, then applies the requested description. Reports the resulting resource names without depending on another test case or changing anything else.

test_cases.description: Launch one evaluation using stable, pre-existing reviewer fixtures.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find and retrieve the agent Review Voice Agent, test set Directory Review Baseline, persona Standard Customer, and metric Directory Review: Helpful and Safe. After confirmation, launch exactly one evaluation using those four resources with tags openai-review and directory-review. Retrieve the new run once and report its current status.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_agents, get_agent, list_test_sets, get_test_set, list_personas, get_persona, list_metrics, get_metric, create_run, get_run
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves only the named stable fixtures, launches exactly one evaluation after confirmation, and reports its identifier and current status. It does not depend on resources created by another test and starts no additional run.

test_cases.description: Use Sofia for bounded, standalone evaluation guidance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask Sofia this standalone question: A completed Coval run has exactly two outputs and its only current metric is Turn Count, with scores 10 and 44. Recommend exactly one additional metric that would tell us whether the agent completed the user's task, and explain in one sentence what it would catch. Do not create or update anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls Sofia once with only the bounded standalone prompt, with no conversation history or session identifier. Returns one task-success or task-completion metric recommendation and a concise rationale, and performs no writes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Coval for an unrelated calendar-management request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move my afternoon call?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Coval app is not invoked because it cannot read or change calendar events.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger Coval for an unrelated Slack-messaging request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send "Lunch has moved to 12:30 PM" to the #general Slack channel.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Coval app is not invoked because it cannot send Slack messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not substitute available write tools for an unsupported bulk destructive request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete every agent and test set in this organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that the connector does not expose bulk deletion tools and makes no changes.
